records.specification_basis: Ferrari's technical summary gives five forward speeds plus reverse. The period report describes a short gear lever operating a gear gate; no paddle or sequential actuation is described for this 1975 configuration. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema.
